name: beautiful-j2ee
description: Write, review, port, and enforce idiomatic Java enterprise backends on J2EE / Jakarta EE 11: three skills distilled from the Jakarta EE specification, the Jakarta/MicroProfile guides, and the facta J2EE handbook, plus a drop-in Checkstyle config.

interface.longDescription:
Three skills for Java enterprise developers on J2EE / Jakarta EE 11, distilled from the Jakarta EE specification, the Jakarta and MicroProfile guides, and the facta J2EE handbook.

j2ee-best-practices guides new backend code: Maven modules that enforce the domain/application/adapters/presentation layers, CDI constructor injection, JTA use-case transactions, JPA/Hibernate with optimistic locking, schema-level tenant isolation with PostgreSQL RLS, the transactional outbox and JMS, JAX-RS with DTOs and the platform error envelope, Jakarta Security and MicroProfile config/observability, and app-server deployment.

j2ee-review reviews a resource, use case, JPA adapter, module graph, outbox/JMS path, migration, security/tenant change, or diff and returns a prioritized report. Architecture and transaction/tenant contracts rank above everything. Every finding cites a file and line, the rule it breaks, and the smallest fix.

j2ee-port ports Spring Boot, Java EE 8 (javax.*), EJB/JSF or a legacy servlet app to Jakarta EE 11 with the same behavior. It ports the original tests first and writes a PORTING.md.

The skills contain instructions and reference text only. They make no network calls and collect no data. When a JDK/Maven toolchain is available, the skills run Maven, Checkstyle, SpotBugs and the test suite; without one, they work from the code alone. A drop-in Checkstyle config is available in the GitHub repository.
capabilities: Review J2EE code with cited rules
Port Spring or Java EE 8 to Jakarta EE 11
defaultPrompt: Review this JAX-RS resource and list what to fix first
Port this Spring service to Jakarta EE CDI
Check the tenant isolation and transaction boundary

publication.release_notes: Initial release: three J2EE skills, the module and tenant-isolation contract, and a proven Checkstyle config.
